code: fn shell_sort(a: &mut [i32]) { let n = a.len(); let mut gap = n / 2; while gap > 0 { for i in gap..n { let mut j = i; let tmp = a[i]; while j >= gap && a[j - gap] > tmp { a[j] = a[j - gap]; j -= gap; } a[j] = tmp; } gap /= 2; } }

description-zh: 二叉堆实现的堆排序
code: fn heap_sort(a: &mut [i32]) { let n = a.len(); for i in (0..n/2).rev() { heapify(a, n, i); } for i in (1..n).rev() { a.swap(0, i); heapify(a, i, 0); } } fn heapify(a: &mut [i32], n: usize, i: usize) { let mut largest = i; let l = 2*i+1; let r = 2*i+2; if l < n && a[l] > a[largest] { largest = l; } if r < n && a[r] > a[largest] { largest = r; } if largest != i { a.swap(i, largest); heapify(a, n, largest); } }

description-zh: 计数排序（适用于小范围整数）
description-en: Counting sort for small integer range
code: fn counting_sort(a: &[i32], max: i32) -> Vec<i32> { let mut cnt = vec![0i32; (max+1) as usize]; for &v in a { cnt[v as usize] += 1; } let mut res = Vec::new(); for (i, &c) in cnt.iter().enumerate() { res.extend(std::iter::repeat(i as i32).take(c as usize)); } res }

description-zh: Boyer-Moore 字符串匹配（坏字符规则）
description-en: Boyer-Moore string matching with bad character rule
code: fn boyer_moore(text: &str, pattern: &str) -> Option<usize> { let n = text.len(); let m = pattern.len(); if m == 0 { return Some(0); } let mut bc = [m; 256]; for (i, c) in pattern.char_indices() { bc[c as usize] = m - i - 1; } let mut shift = 0; while shift <= n.saturating_sub(m) { let mut j = m; while j > 0 && pattern.chars().nth(j-1) == text.chars().nth(shift+j-1) { j -= 1; } if j == 0 { return Some(shift); } let c = text.chars().nth(shift+j-1).unwrap_or('\0') as usize; shift += (j - bc[c]).max(1); } None }

description-zh: Sunday 字符串匹配算法
code: fn sunday(text: &str, pattern: &str) -> Option<usize> { let n = text.len(); let m = pattern.len(); if m == 0 { return Some(0); } let mut shift = [m+1; 256]; for (i, c) in pattern.char_indices() { shift[c as usize] = m - i; } let mut pos = 0; while pos <= n.saturating_sub(m) { let mut j = 0; while j < m && text.chars().nth(pos+j) == pattern.chars().nth(j) { j += 1; } if j == m { return Some(pos); } let next_pos = pos + m; if next_pos < n { let c = text.chars().nth(next_pos).unwrap() as usize; pos += shift[c]; } else { return None; } } None }

description-zh: 令牌桶限流器实现
code:
use std::time::{Duration, Instant};
pub struct TokenBucket { rate: f64, tokens: f64, last_update: Instant } impl TokenBucket { pub fn new(rate: f64, burst: usize) -> Self { Self { rate, tokens: burst as f64, last_update: Instant::now() } } pub fn allow(&mut self) -> bool { let now = Instant::now(); let elapsed = now.duration_since(self.last_update).as_secs_f64(); self.last_update = now; self.tokens = (self.tokens + elapsed * self.rate).min(self.tokens.max(self.tokens as f64) as f64); if self.tokens >= 1.0 { self.tokens -= 1.0; true } else { false } } } }

description-zh: 简单布隆过滤器实现
无锁 FIFO 环形缓冲区
code:
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicUsize, Ordering};
pub struct RingBuffer<T> { buf: Vec<T>, cap: usize, head: AtomicUsize, tail: AtomicUsize } impl<T: Clone + Default> RingBuffer<T> { pub fn new(capacity: usize) -> Self { Self { buf: vec![T::default(); capacity], cap: capacity, head: AtomicUsize::new(0), tail: AtomicUsize::new(0) } } pub fn push(&self, v: T) -> bool { let tail = self.tail.load(Ordering::Relaxed); let head = self.head.load(Ordering::Relaxed); if tail.wrapping_sub(head) >= self.cap { return false; } self.buf[tail % self.cap] = v; self.tail.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed); true } pub fn pop(&self) -> Option<T> { let tail = self.tail.load(Ordering::Relaxed); let head = self.head.load(Ordering::Relaxed); if tail == head { return None; } let v = self.buf[head % self.cap].clone(); self.head.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed); Some(v) } }
